title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2611.24924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world harness engineering is driven by explicit and implicit user requirements, which guide development and validation. However, existing harness evolution methods often overlook implicit requirements and interaction needs, while using a single evolution agent to modify the harness and benchmark scores to select changes. This process often produces narrow patches and leads to benchmark-specific local optima. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering Beta (AHE-Beta), a requirement-centered loop that brings real-world engineering practices into harness evolution. translated_title: 智能体框架工程Beta：以需求为中心的智能体框架演进
translated_abstract: 现实世界的框架工程由显性与隐性用户需求驱动，这些需求指导着开发与验证过程。然而，现有的框架演进方法往往忽视隐性需求和交互需求，同时使用单一演进智能体来修改框架，并依赖基准测试分数来选择变更。这一过程常常产生狭窄的补丁，并导致针对特定基准的局部最优。我们提出智能体框架工程Beta（AHE-Beta），这是一个以需求为中心的循环，将现实世界的工程实践引入框架演进。该循环包含三个步骤：（1）用户驱动评估：让模拟用户在与框架进行多轮交互的过程中，以问题（issue）的形式提出需求；（2）基于团队的修改：将这些需求实现为可泛化的变更，而非特定任务的补丁；（3）需求驱动选择：仅当变更解决了经验证的需求时才将其合并。
tldr: 提出AHE-Beta，一个以需求为中心的智能体框架演进循环，通过模拟用户提出需求、团队协作实现可泛化变更以及基于经验证需求选择变更，解决了现有方法产生狭窄补丁和基准局部最优的问题。
en_tdlr: AHE-Beta is a requirement-centered loop for agent harness evolution that combines user-driven evaluation, team-based generalizable modifications, and requirement-verified selection, avoiding narrow patches and benchmark-specific local optima.
